title: Sakerplus® Outdoor Flexible-Neck Work Flashlight
body_html:
FEATURES

  • 360° Wide Range Lighting: Featuring a head that can rotate and three LED lights that emit a powerful brightness, this telescopic pick up tool with magnetic capabilities offers a 360° illumination range. This allows you the flexibility to adjust the height and angle of the flashlight according to your preference, making this hand tool an essential tool for quickly finding and retrieving items in narrow and inaccessible areas.

  • Easily Pickup From Unreachable Spot: This Magnetic Pick-Up Tool with LED is both magnet and light, making seeing and snagging easier than ever when finding nuts, bolts, and tools if they fall in hard to reach places. No more worries for professional mechanics, carpenters, maintenance workers, and everyday homeowners to retrieve metal tools.

  • Adjustable Telescopic Design: The tool extends from compact size to telescopic length, providing the flexibility to reach tight spaces and retrieve items with ease. The telescoping design makes it easy to carry and store, and it comes with a free lightweight battery for easy use. The flashlight can extend from 6.69 inches to 22.64 inches, providing enough length to help you pick up metal items from hard-to-reach places.

  • Durable and Versatile: Crafted from high-hardness Aluminum alloy, this magnet tool is weatherproof and shockproof, guaranteeing long-lasting durability. Whether you're camping, tackling repairs, working on handicrafts, or facing roadside emergencies, these tools are designed for unwavering dependability in any situation.

  • Widely Application: Perfect for daily use, home improvement, construction, carpentry, auto repair, electrical, DIY projects, or taking outdoors while hunting boating, camping, and fishing. Very useful in car, household, office, industry and garage. The small clip fixes the flashlight in your pocket so that you can carry it with you without falling, cool gadgets for man.

SPECIFICATIONS

  • Colors: Black

  • Power source: LR44 (AG13) batteries included

  • Light source: LED

  • Dimensions: 2 x 17.5 cm (0.8 x 6.69 in); extended length: 2 x 57 cm (0.8 x 22.4 in)

  • Usage: Multifunctional work light for auto repair / household use

  • Weight: Approx. 102 g

PACKAGE

  • 1 * Outdoor Flexible-Neck Work Flashlight
